description:
We are seeking a ReRAM Memory and AI Development Engineer to advance resistive random-access memory (ReRAM) technology and develop AI-enabled solutions that improve semiconductor engineering productivity and technical capability.

 The role combines hands-on ReRAM technology development with the broader application of machine learning, generative AI, physics-informed AI, and AI agents across semiconductor engineering. The successful candidate will bridge semiconductor device knowledge, data science, AI/ML, EDA, and software development to turn new concepts into practical engineering solutions.

 
 ReRAM Technology Development

 Develop and characterize ReRAM technology, including SET/RESET behavior, resistance distributions, variability, endurance, reliability, and operating margins.

 Develop device, statistical, and behavioral models linking ReRAM characteristics to circuit and system requirements.

 Analyze device and array data to support technology optimization, design enablement, and reliability assessment.

 Collaborate with process integration, device, modeling, design, reliability, and test teams to advance ReRAM technology.

 Evaluate ReRAM for embedded memory, compute-in-memory, and other emerging applications.

 AI-Enabled Engineering

 Develop and deploy AI solutions to improve engineering productivity, technical capability, and decision-making across semiconductor development, not limited to ReRAM

 Apply machine learning, generative AI, physics-informed AI, and AI agents to engineering problems such as:

 Device and process modeling

 Engineering data analysis and visualization

 Simulation and design-space exploration

 EDA and design automation

 Model generation and optimization

 Technical knowledge retrieval and synthesis

 Engineering workflow, documentation, and repetitive-task automation

 Identify high-value opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort, accelerate analysis, or enable new engineering capabilities.

 Prototype emerging AI technologies and transition successful concepts into practical tools for engineering teams.

 Promote effective AI adoption through technical collaboration, demonstrations, documentation, and knowledge sharing.



  

 
 
 Ph.D. or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics, Computer Science, or a related field.

 Strong foundation in semiconductor devices, memory technologies, EDA, or semiconductor engineering.

 Experience with machine learning, deep learning, and scientific computing.

 Strong Python programming skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch or equivalent.

 Experience developing data-driven or physics-informed engineering models.

 Ability to translate semiconductor engineering challenges into modeling, AI, software, or automation solutions.

 Strong cross-functional communication and technical problem-solving skills.

 Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with ReRAM or other emerging memory technologies, including device characterization, modeling, variability, endurance, or reliability.

 Experience with physics-informed machine learning, generative AI, probabilistic modeling, LLMs, or AI agents.

 Experience with semiconductor EDA and simulation tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys Custom Compiler, Sentaurus TCAD, HSPICE, or Verilog-A.

 Experience with compute-in-memory, memory-aware AI, or neural-network quantization.

 Experience developing reusable engineering automation, analysis, or AI software tools.

  

 
 
 onsemi  (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.
